title: 美国医疗最复杂的地方：数据孤岛加劳动密集，AI重构中心卡在哪一环？
speaker: Alvin Leo

segments.en: This incredibly important industry is entering what we believe is at once in a generation rebuild of its workflows and infrastructure with AI at this very center.
segments.zh: 这个极其重要的行业正进入我们眼中的一代人一次的工作流与基础设施重构，而AI正处于核心位置。

segments.en: The healthcare industry in the U.S., it's incredibly complex and administratively, will all silo data and labor intensive workflows.
segments.zh: 美国医疗行业极其复杂，行政层面充满数据孤岛和劳动密集型工作流。

segments.en: These are all very primed to be disrupted by AI, and this is where we see a lot of interesting investment opportunities.
segments.zh: 这些都非常适合被AI改造，也是我们看到许多有趣配置机会的地方。
